title: What is PocketVC?
author: PocketVC Team
description: Learn about PocketVC's mission to connect VCs with innovative startups through smart matching technology.
content:
PocketVC is a curated platform that connects venture capital firms with innovative startups. We go beyond simple matching by understanding the DNA of each startup and the investment thesis of each VC to create meaningful, high-quality connections.

Our platform helps:

  • VCs: Discover relevant startups that align with their investment focus and portfolio strategy
  • Startups: Connect with the right investors who understand their market and can add value beyond capital
  • Both: Save time by reducing the noise and focusing on quality matches

We're building the future of startup-investor matching through advanced AI and deep market understanding.

title: Who is PocketVC for?
author: PocketVC Team
description: Find out if PocketVC is right for your VC firm or startup.
content:
PocketVC is designed for two main audiences:

For Venture Capital Firms:

  • Early-stage to growth-stage VCs looking for quality deal flow
  • Investors focused on specific sectors (deep tech, fintech, healthtech, etc.)
  • VCs who want to reduce time spent on irrelevant pitches
  • Investment teams looking to expand their network of innovative startups

For Startups:

  • Early-stage to Series A startups seeking funding
  • Companies with innovative technology or business models
  • Startups looking for investors who can provide strategic value
  • Founders who want to connect with the right VCs efficiently

We focus on quality over quantity, ensuring both sides find meaningful connections.

title: How do I join PocketVC?
author: PocketVC Team
description: Simple steps to get started with PocketVC as a VC or startup.
content:
Joining PocketVC is simple and free:

For Startups:

  1. Sign up for our waitlist at PocketVC.co
  2. Complete your startup profile with key information
  3. Upload your pitch deck and company details
  4. Our AI will analyze your startup and match you with relevant VCs
  5. Start receiving curated investor introductions

For VCs:

  1. Contact us through our website
  2. Provide your investment thesis and focus areas
  3. Set your preferences for startup types and stages
  4. Receive curated startup recommendations
  5. Connect with founders who match your criteria

We're currently in beta, so early access is limited. Join our waitlist to be notified when we launch!

title: Is PocketVC free to use?
author: PocketVC Team
description: Learn about PocketVC's pricing model and free features.
content:
Yes! PocketVC is completely free for startups. We believe that great startups shouldn't be limited by their ability to pay for access to investors.

For Startups:

  • Free forever: No subscription fees, no per-introduction charges
  • Unlimited matches: Connect with as many relevant VCs as you want
  • Full platform access: All features and tools are included

For VCs:

  • Free during beta: No charges while we perfect the platform
  • Future pricing: We'll introduce reasonable pricing for VCs post-launch
  • Value-based: Pricing will be based on the value we provide to your deal flow

Our mission is to democratize access to venture capital, so we're committed to keeping the platform accessible to startups.

title: How do you protect my data and privacy?
author: PocketVC Team
description: Learn about PocketVC's commitment to data protection and privacy.
content:
Data security and privacy are fundamental to everything we do at PocketVC. We understand that startups and VCs share sensitive information, and we protect it with enterprise-grade security.

Data Protection:

  • Encryption: All data is encrypted in transit and at rest
  • Access controls: Strict access controls and authentication
  • Regular audits: Third-party security audits and penetration testing
  • GDPR compliant: Full compliance with European data protection regulations

Privacy Controls:

  • You control your data: You decide what information to share and with whom
  • No data selling: We never sell or share your data with third parties
  • Transparent matching: You can see why you were matched with someone
  • Easy deletion: You can delete your account and data at any time

Read our full Privacy Policy for complete details.

title: When will PocketVC launch?
author: PocketVC Team
description: Get the latest updates on PocketVC's launch timeline.
content:
We're working hard to bring PocketVC to market as quickly as possible while ensuring we deliver a high-quality platform.

Current Timeline:

  • Q1 2025: Private beta with select VCs and startups
  • Q2 2025: Public beta launch
  • Q3 2025: Full platform launch

How to Stay Updated:

  • Join our waitlist to be notified of updates
  • Follow us on social media for the latest news
  • Check our blog for development updates

We're moving fast but won't compromise on quality. Our goal is to create the best possible experience for both VCs and startups from day one.

Want early access? Join our waitlist and we'll prioritize you for beta access!
